questions.stem: Which greeting fits a six o'clock evening revision session?

options.text: Bonjour is appropriate in the evening.
Bonsoir is appropriate in the evening.
Salut is appropriate in the evening.
options.misconception: uses informal register in formal text

options.text: Bonne nuit is appropriate in the evening.

questions.explanation: Bonsoir fits the evening. Bonjour and bonne nuit belong to other times.

questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: Farewells and the formality they carry
questions.stem: Leaving a formal study group session, which farewell carries the right formality?

options.misconception: uses informal register in formal text

questions.explanation: Au revoir suits a formal setting. Slang farewells ignore social distance.

questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.stem: You need a stranger's name in the study group; write a polite question.

answer.exemplar: Excusez-moi, comment vous appelez-vous, s'il vous plait ? is polite and direct.

questions.explanation: A polite request uses excusez-moi and s'il vous plait. Blunt phrasing would be rude.
questions.hint: Add excusez-moi and s'il vous plait.
